picks.title: Pattaya Moves Forward With Tourist Assistance Centre at Bali Hai Pier to Improve Safety and Services
picks.memo: Pattaya City with provincial tourism office and Marine Department plans a tourist assistance centre at Bali Hai Pier (Koh Larn route); temporary 6x10 m centre proposed; meeting Oct 26 with Mayor Poramese.

picks.title: Four Defendants Plead Guilty to All Nine Charges in Triple Murder Case of Thai Family at Pattaya Provincial Court
picks.memo: Oct 26 hearing at Pattaya Provincial Court: 4 defendants pleaded guilty to all 9 charges (premeditated murder, armed robbery, impersonating police, guns, concealing bodies); case linked to killings of two Russian siblings.

picks.title: Pattaya Meets Bahrain–Thailand Business Association to Discuss Tourism Cooperation
picks.memo: Mayor Poramese met Bahrain–Thailand Business & Friendship Association delegation (led by Khalifa Al-Rumaihi) Oct 26 at City Hall to promote Pattaya to Bahrain/Middle East visitors.

picks.title: วินมอเตอร์ไซค์พัทยา ทยอยคืนเสื้อวินสีน้ำเงิน หลักฐานครบ ถึงได้เงินคืน 550 บาท
picks.memo: Pattaya/Banglamung motorbike taxi riders returning the new dark-blue vests at Banglamung district office and getting 550 baht refunds after the orange-to-blue vest change was reversed over visibility/cost criticism.

picks.title: EEC sees three-airport high-speed rail at risk ahead of board review
picks.memo: Don Mueang–Suvarnabhumi–U-Tapao high-speed rail may collapse: CP sought to end contract, banks declined funding (EECO chief Chula, Oct 26). PM Anutin says contract still binding; disputes to court if no deal; EEC board to decide in November.

picks.title: อีอีซีไฟเขียวพื้นที่ลงทุนใหม่ 4 แห่ง 2.56 หมื่นล้าน สร้างงานกว่า 1.8 หมื่นตำแหน่ง
picks.memo: EEC board (meeting 3/2569, chaired by PM Anutin) approved 4 new special promotion zones, about 25,664 million baht investment, 18,000+ jobs; currently 47 zones.

picks.title: “สุรศักดิ์” รมว.ท่องเที่ยวฯ จ่อชง “ฟรีวีซ่า” 15 วัน กลุ่มละตินอเมริกาหลังตัวเลข “เม็กซิโก-โคลัมเบีย” วูบหนัก
picks.memo: Tourism minister Surasak to propose 15-day visa-free entry for Latin American markets; operators say slow Thai visa processing hit Mexico/Colombia, 20-30% postponed/cancelled trips.

picks.title: Israeli arrested on drug and sex charges threatens police and well known detective Inspector Jae
picks.memo: Israeli man, 54, arrested in Bangkok Friday; police seized crystal meth, suspected drug-laced cake, secret videos; immigration found 2,095-day overstay; Thai woman, 44, also arrested.

picks.title: BMA seeks over B1bn in extra relief
picks.memo: BMA to seek over 1 billion baht more flood relief and ordered district chiefs to draw a new flood risk map after recent Bangkok flooding.

picks.title: สภาพอากาศวันนี้ กรมอุตุฯ เปิดชื่อ 41 จังหวัด เตือนฝนตกหนักถึงหนักมาก
picks.memo: TMD forecast Oct 27: heavy to very heavy rain in 41 provinces, 60% of area; South continues heavy rain (flash flood risk), upper Thailand less rain but unsettled, Bangkok area included.

picks.title: Thai Prime Minister Orders Urgent Cleanup and Relief Efforts Following Phuket Floods
picks.memo: PM Anutin ordered faster cleanup after Patong flash flood/mudslides early Oct 26; 142.8 mm in 24h; more rain expected.

picks.title: Special Branch and cyber police move against the ‘Godd Dam’ Facebook page after PM ‘tea money’ fake
picks.memo: Fake 7 million baht transfer slip naming PM Anutin posted by 'Godd Dam' page (130,000 followers); Kasikornbank said fake; suspected operator a 26-year-old ex-Move Forward member; police say no arrest yet and sharers may face same offence.

picks.title: Expanded solar for households scheme for cabinet approval Tuesday
picks.memo: 50,000 baht subsidy per household for rooftop solar, up to 1 million households, to cabinet Tuesday (Oct 27); low-interest loans from 3 state banks (Finance Minister Ekniti).

picks.title: Sophon says censure will go ahead
picks.memo: House Speaker Sophon says no-confidence debate will happen before session ends; government and opposition still disagree on schedule (Nov or Dec).

picks.title: Thaksin amnesty petition awaits review
picks.memo: Justice permanent secretary Piyasiri says his subcommittee has not yet received Thaksin's amnesty request for 4 political cases (2005-2016).

picks.title: Ministry faces shortage  of doctor posts by 2029
picks.memo: Mahidol study: Public Health Ministry could run out of civil-service doctor posts by 2029; 5,442 new doctors without posts by 2040 unless ceiling expanded.

picks.title: Nuclear study accelerated in bid to install reactors by 2037
picks.memo: Egat accelerating nuclear study; target first commercial small modular reactor (SMR) by 2037 under 2026 Power Development Plan.

picks.title: Office projects exports to expand by 15-16% in 2026
picks.memo: Commerce Ministry TPSO projects 2026 exports +15-16%, driven by electronics and AI infrastructure demand.

picks.title: Seven-language 7-Eleven worker goes viral in Thailand
picks.memo: 48-year-old 7-Eleven assistant manager 'Tony' (Teerawat) at BITEC Bang Na speaks 7 languages; went viral via TikTok video.

picks.title: Naga Fireballs: Thailand’s unexplained lights draw crowds to the Mekong
picks.memo: Crowds gathered at Wat Thai, Phon Phisai, Nong Khai along the Mekong for annual Naga Fireballs at end of Buddhist Lent.

picks.title: Thailand, Laos and Myanmar plan shared haze monitoring system
picks.memo: Thai MFA launched CLEAR Sky Strategy (2024–2030) with Laos and Myanmar: shared fire-risk mapping and real-time pollution monitoring, joint working group.

picks.title: Headman apologises after 11 sakura trees cut at Doi Pui as probe widens
picks.memo: Suthep subdistrict headman apologised Oct 26 after volunteers cut 15 trees incl. 11 Thai sakura at Ban Hmong Doi Pui viewpoint in Doi Suthep-Pui National Park; police identified 7 suspects.

picks.title: ผช.ผบ.ตร. สั่งด่วน ย้ำจราจรห้ามสวมหมวกไอ้โม่ง ปิดบังใบหน้า โทษปรับ ต้องตักเตือนก่อน
picks.memo: Oct 26 urgent police order: traffic police must not wear face-covering balaclavas on duty; enforcement 'warn before fine' and stepped fines, except serious offences (wrong-way, red light, drunk driving, racing).
